sources.entry: Little Snitch - Network monitor with a world map for visualizing network connections.

summary.name: Little Snitch
summary.one_liner: Little Snitch is a macOS network monitor and firewall from Objective Development, and this page explains how to verify the code signature of its downloaded disk image.
use_cases: Verify that a downloaded Little Snitch disk image is genuine and unmodified
Monitor network connections made by apps on a Mac
Visualize network connections on a world map
summary.what_it_does: The page is a download page for Little Snitch. It gives instructions for checking the cryptographic signature of the downloaded .dmg file using the macOS codesign command in Terminal, with the Objective Development team identifier. A successful check (no error output) indicates the file is intact and signed by Objective Development; an error indicates it may have been modified and should not be opened. The listing on awesome-mac describes Little Snitch as a network monitor with a world map for visualizing connections. The page text does not describe further features or pricing.
notable: Network monitor with a world map for visualizing connections
Download page includes codesign verification steps for the .dmg file
caveats: Page text does not state pricing or whether a trial or paid license is required
Only macOS is named on the page
